outline.title: Authority and trust: the decision the operator made
Amendment (operator, 2026-11-15): a session with no project is given shared research

line.text: status: approved   # by the operator, 2026-11-14, in a host session: "115: your suggestions are approved" (the default `workspace` and the private flag of section 8). Open question 2 was settled later the same day ("1. follow your direction"): claims from private and internal sources are shared under the three guards of section 2.3. Section 10 (2026-11-15) is an amendment written from the operator's words of that day; it takes effect when the operator merges its pull request.

summary.text:
| # | Observation (2026-11-14) |
| :-- | :-- |
| E-1 | The index shows a project's files only to a session with that project's id (`kb.rs`, the project filter). Tests assert that another project gets nothing. |
| E-2 | A research run inside a project writes to that project and never to the shared index (`research.rs`, the destination rule). |
| E-3 | Project knowledge reaches the rest of the workspace only by promotion, one item at a time, on the operator's accept. |
| E-4 | On a live workspace with eight projects, a search from one project for subjects researched in two others returned nothing about them. |
